title: 第9章我就喜欢玩儿阴的，小舞是一只兔子-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    赵无极眉头微微一皱，有点疑惑地望向戴沐白。

    倘若真是如此，戴沐白就太丢人了。

    身为一名男人，被打败了不重要，但被吓尿了，那就不应该了。

    唐三、小舞和宁荣荣，大眼瞪小眼，也被叶寒的话惊了一跳。

    尤其是宁荣荣，就在刚才，戴沐白还向她热情的介绍了史莱克学院的情况，以及他的真实魂力等级。

    戴沐白可是三十七级战魂尊，而且还是强大的邪眸白虎武魂。

    如此强悍的实力，怎么会被叶寒击败，还被吓尿了。

    他的实力到底有多强。

    “我......”

    戴沐白听到赵无极的质问，不知道怎么回答，只能铁青着脸，支支吾吾的。

    此时，他真想找个地方钻进去，在看向叶寒的眼神中也充满了怨恨。

    “好了，我知道了。”

    “竟然你不是对手，还是让我亲自试一试吧。”

    “小子，你出招吧。”

    “在我不使用魂技的情况下，你只需要坚持一炷香的时间，就算你通过考核。”

    赵无极太了解戴沐白的性格了。

    看到他刚才的反应，他就已经知道了答案。

    正如叶寒所讲的那样，戴沐白的确败了，而且还被吓尿了。

    他倒要瞧瞧，叶寒的实力到底有多强，是如何能将戴沐白吓尿的。

    “好，你出手吧。”

    叶寒倒是不在乎时间。

    他只在乎赵无极的实力有多强。

    根据系统分析，魂圣应该是斗罗大陆的顶尖强者，可以称霸一方的存在。

    刚好他可以见识一下，这个世界的修炼体系到底有多强，以后遇到这类强者，应该如何应对，算是给自己积累更高强度的实战经验。

    赵无极和戴沐白等人闻言，都傻眼了。

    让一个魂圣先出手，叶寒的脑子秀逗了吧。

    “你小子，气人倒是有一手。”

    “行吧，我便满足你的要求。”

    赵无极有点生气了，也没有唤出武魂，抡起拳头，砸去。

    “杀拳！”

    叶寒可不敢小视赵无极的实力，虽然没有唤出武魂，但却拿出他最得意的招式。

    一拳轰出，杀气凛然，爆发出一股令人心寒胆战的杀意。

    赵无极感知，表情微微一愣。

    他没想到，叶寒竟然能释放出如此恐怖的杀气，而且还将其凝聚在拳头上。

    就在他发愣之际，叶寒的杀拳撞击在赵无极的拳头上。

    无论是叶寒，还是赵无极，都感觉自己的拳头像是砸在了钢板上。

    强大的力量都让两人眉头一皱，纷纷倒退了几步，才稳定身形。

    众人看到这一幕，都震惊了。

    尤其是宁荣荣，惊得她目瞪口呆的。

    赵无极是七十六级魂圣，纵然不用武魂，这一拳的威力也不弱，魂王以下几乎很难承受。

    可是，叶寒竟然在不使用武魂的情况下，不仅将其抵挡了下来，好像还没有落入下风。

    如此惊人的实力，让她难以相信。

    此时此刻，她都有点后怕了。

    如果叶寒当时动手了，她或许就没命了。

    “好小子，果然有点能耐。”

    “难怪能击败沐白。”

    “既然如此，我可就认真了。”

    回神过来的赵无极，对叶寒的实力给予肯定，唤出大力金刚熊武魂，准备好好的打一场。

    以他的实力，纵然不用魂技，也能轻松击败任何魂王。

    这就是他的底气。

    “是大力金刚熊武魂！”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhao Wuji frowned slightly and looked at Dai Mubai in confusion.

If this is really the case, Dai Mubai would be so embarrassed.

As a man, being defeated is not important, but being scared to the point of peeing is not important.

Tang San, Xiao Wu and Ning Rongrong stared at each other, also startled by Ye Han's words.

Especially Ning Rongrong, just now, Dai Mubai enthusiastically introduced to her the situation of Shrek Academy and his true soul power level.

Dai Mubai is a thirty-seventh level fighting soul master, and he is also a powerful evil-eyed white tiger martial soul.

How could such a powerful person be defeated by Ye Han and even be scared to death?

How strong is he?

"I..."

When Dai Mubai heard Zhao Wuji's question, he didn't know how to answer, so he could only hesitate and hesitate with a livid face.

At this time, he really wanted to find a place to get in, and the eyes he looked at Ye Han were full of resentment.

"Okay, I get it."

"You are no match for me, so let me give it a try myself."

"Boy, take action."

"When I don't use soul skills, you only need to hold on for one stick of incense, and you will pass the assessment."

Zhao Wuji knows Dai Mubai’s character very well.

Seeing his reaction just now, he already knew the answer.

As Ye Han said, Dai Mubai was indeed defeated, and he was even scared to the point of peeing.

He wanted to see how strong Ye Han was and how he could scare Dai Mubai to the point of peeing.

"Okay, take action."

Ye Han doesn't care about time.

He only cares about how strong Zhao Wuji is.

According to the system analysis, the Soul Saint should be the top powerhouse in Douluo Continent and can dominate one side.

It just so happens that he can see how strong the cultivation system in this world is, and how to deal with such strong people in the future, so as to accumulate more intense practical experience for himself.

When Zhao Wuji, Dai Mubai and others heard this, they were all dumbfounded.

" Let a soul saint take action first, Ye Han's mind will be funny."

"You kid, you're good at making people angry."

"Okay, I will satisfy your request."

Zhao Wuji was a little angry, but without summoning his martial spirit, he raised his fist and smashed it away.

"Killing punch!"

Ye Han didn't dare to underestimate Zhao Wuji's strength. Although he didn't summon the martial spirit, he still used his most proud move.

With one punch, the murderous aura erupted, and a chilling killing intent erupted.

Zhao Wuji felt it and his expression was slightly startled.

He didn’t expect that Ye Han could release such terrifying murderous intent and condense it into his fists.

Just when he was in a daze, Ye Han's killing fist hit Zhao Wuji's fist.

Both Ye Han and Zhao Wuji felt as if their fists had hit the steel plate.

The powerful force made both of them frown, and they took a few steps back before stabilizing their bodies.

Everyone was shocked when they saw this scene.

Especially Ning Rongrong, she was stunned.

Zhao Wuji is a level 76 soul saint. Even if he doesn't use his martial soul, the power of this punch is not weak. It is almost difficult for those below the soul king to withstand it.

However, Ye Han not only resisted it without using his martial spirit, but also seemed to not be at a disadvantage.

Such amazing strength was unbelievable to her.

At this moment, she was a little scared.

“If Ye Han had taken action at that time, she might have died.

"What a good boy, you are indeed quite capable."

"No wonder he can defeat Mubai."

“In that case, I’m serious about it.”

Zhao Wuji, who came back to his senses, affirmed Ye Han's strength, summoned the powerful Vajra Bear martial spirit, and prepared for a good fight.

With his strength, even without using soul skills, he can easily defeat any soul king.

This is his confidence.

"It's the powerful Vajra Bear martial spirit!"
